intro: Lesson 59: Elements, atoms and symbols. To understand that elements are made of one type of atom and are shown by chemical symbols

questions.q: What is the difference between Co and CO?
questions.a: Co is cobalt (one element); CO is carbon and oxygen joined (carbon monoxide)
questions.model: Look at the capitals. Each capital starts a new element. Co: one capital, one element, cobalt. CO: two capitals, carbon and oxygen.

questions.a: The smallest particle of an element

questions.q: Element hunt: use the periodic table to write the symbols of 15 elements on the sheet, then mark each as metal or non-metal.
questions.a: Correct symbols with metal or non-metal (as on the answer sheet)
questions.model: Teacher finds the first on screen: 'magnesium: Mg, left side, metal'.

questions.q: Find five elements named after places or scientists.
questions.a: e.g. polonium, americium, einsteinium, curium, germanium

questions.q: Why do scientists worldwide use the same symbols?
questions.a: So everyone understands each other whatever their language
